ValidationRule.description:
Prevents invalid status transitions when the prior status was Eligible. Pre-lottery, Eligible can only move to Pre-Offer or back to Submitted. Post-lottery, Eligible can only move to Waitlisted.
*Inactive
ValidationRule.errorMessage: INACTIVE - When a School Application is in Eligible status, it may only progress to: Pre-Lottery: Withdrawn/Declined, Pre-Offer or Submitted. Post-Lottery: Waitlisted.
